S.FORM: O kaacangan no Taywan koni Piwansyawan hananay a romi'ad, marecaday to Pisyongacan, Cing-ming(Pipoyfongan), Twan^o(Pipak-cangan), Cong-yin , ato Cong-ciw a romi'ad, saheto o tadamaanay a romi'ad no misaTaywanay, misaNgayngayay ato misaHolamay. O Piwansyawan a romi'ad i, itiraay i saka safaw lima a romi'ad no saka cecay a folad no mihecahecaan(o katelangay a koyomi ko pinengnengan). Minengneng to masamaamaanay, makapahay a nisanga'an a malikatay a tingkitingki i Piwansyawan, ato mitatamatama to montay a misalama .
S.PHON: [o|u] kaaʦaŋan n[o|u] tajwan k[o|u]ni piwansjawan ħananaj a r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ] marəʦa[ɬ|ɮ]aj t[o|u] pisj[o|u]ŋaʦan ʦiŋmiŋpip[o|u]jf[o|u]ŋan twanʔ[o|u]pipakʦaŋan ʦ[o|u]ŋjin at[o|u] ʦ[o|u]ŋʦiw a r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ] saħət[o|u] [o|u] ta[ɬ|ɮ]amaanaj a r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] misatajwanaj misaŋajŋajaj at[o|u] misaħ[o|u]ɾamaj [o|u] piwansjawan a r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ] i itiraaj i saka safaw ɾima a r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] saka ʦəʦaj a f[o|u]ɾa[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] miħəʦaħəʦaan[o|u] katəɾaŋaj a k[o|u]j[o|u]mi k[o|u] pinəŋnəŋan minəŋnəŋ t[o|u] masamaamaanaj makapaħaj a nisaŋaʡan a maɾikataj a tiŋkitiŋki i piwansjawan at[o|u] mitatamatama t[o|u] m[o|u]ntaj a misaɾama
